purpose: Prepare two independently built app candidates A/B from one fixed reviewed source using the existing workflow. No ECR/registry publication, catalog insertion, environment restore or release deployment.
sequence: Verify unchanged local scope/verifier hashes; after explicit approval create fresh private records, then read the existing Git credential helper once in memory. No AWS credentials or Source login check.
Read exact repository identity/default branch, main ref and workflow bytes at the pinned commit. Any mismatch stops before dispatch; do not fetch another commit or change code.
For A, save the one bounded pre-dispatch run-ID sample and create a fresh dispatch INTENT; POST the original workflow once with ref=main and no inputs. Never retry an unknown or failed POST.
Use only bounded read-only discovery to bind one exact new run, then poll only that run. Preserve an unknown dispatch ACK as unknown even if a run is found; do not dispatch B in that case.

On completed/success, obtain that run's one exact checked-app artifact, download the original ZIP, and reuse original extraction/checksum/build/security validators at actual current time. No Docker Desktop, lifecycle image or registry access.
Only after A passes original-artifact verification, recheck main is still the pinned source and follow the same independently recorded baseline/INTENT/one POST/run/artifact sequence for B.

Require different run IDs, valid current artifacts and different verified imageConfigDigest values. Record source-compatible A/B candidates only; leave ECR root/platform digests and release directory IDs unset.

If either build fails, capture the exact job/step metadata and at most one bounded failing-job log, then stop without repair, cancel, rerun or additional build. If digests are identical, report DISTINCT_IMAGE_REQUIRED; do not forge a tag/digest or launch a third build.

operatorApiCalls.accept: repository.id=1064124445, owner.id=14145707, default_branch=main; no redirect to another owner/repository

operatorApiCalls.when: Before A and immediately before B, object.sha must equal the pinned source; no ref writes

operatorApiCalls.accept: Decoded Git raw bytes SHA256 and blob SHA1 equal the approved immutable local Git object; this is not Windows working-tree CRLF bytes

operatorApiCalls.when: One first-page sample immediately before each POST, no pagination

operatorApiCalls.accept: Exactly one request per slot; HTTP204 is the expected ACK. Uncertain submission is never reposted, never clears its intent and never permits B automatically.

One unique new run absent from that slot's prior ID sample, created within the recorded bounded dispatch interval, exact repository/workflow/source/main/event/actor and attempt1. Do not follow another candidate or page; ambiguity/absence stops.
Only the two bound run IDs, their pinned source/workflow/repository/event/main/actor and attempt1; no Re-run or polling unrelated runs
Once on each terminal run, one original app job; capture status/failed step only, incomplete page stops

Exactly one matching nonexpired checked-app for this source/run/attempt1; exact artifact.workflow_run IDs/SHA and original ZIP digest/size. Incomplete artifact page stops; no historical or lifecycle fallback.
Only original API302 then one allowed official blob GET per artifact; never forward Authorization to blob or store signed URL

operatorApiCalls.when: Only first failing bound app job; at most one official signed text-body GET of at most4MiB, private/redacted evidence only. No broad run logs, OS diagnostic ZIP or extra artifact downloads.

transport.credentialUse: Existing Git credential only in memory, sent only to api.github.com; do not read PAT/PEM/.env/AWS Secret or copy credentials to files.
transport.officialBlobHostRule: Existing allowlist: HTTPS *.blob.core.windows.net or *.actions.githubusercontent.com; no userinfo, forwarded Authorization or extra redirects
transport.localDestination: A fresh create-only private child of E:/NodejsProject/TechlongSoftware/.local-secrets; keep original ZIP/receipts and safe hashes, no old directory/fence reset.
transport.localExtractor: Original ops/releases/extract-build-artifact.py via the already available bundled Python; do not use broken Windows python3 alias or install software.

timing.operationEndRule: Earlier of actual start plus80min and actual explicit approval plus5h; do not start when insufficient planned reserve remains.
timing.metadataAgeStartsAt: Actual first GitHub preflight read; not completion of B or later preparation.

stopRules: No retries after HTTP/transport/authentication/integrity/ID mismatch errors; normal status polling of a healthy unchanged run is monitoring, not an error retry.
Fresh intent records are create-only. Unknown POST retains its state; allow only the listed discovery reads, no automatic B or replacement POST.

First build failure, ambiguous run, missing/expired artifact, scanner/security failure, budget/deadline or identical config digests stops this round. No automatic repair, downgrade, cancel, Re-run, third build or resource cleanup.

Queued/running GitHub jobs may continue after local interruption; preserve exact run IDs and evidence, never dispatch again to recover. No cancellation is approved. Subsequent reads must fit remaining original scope/time or be approved separately.

A/B qualification here is build-source evidence only. ECR publication, actual root/platform digest verification, trusted catalog, initial binding, media operations, runtime activation/restoration and two real updates remain separately approved.
risks: Up to two existing GitHub-hosted app jobs, each timeout25min, may consume Actions minutes, dependency/OS downloads and artifact/log storage or incur GitHub fees; no plan/billing upgrade or AWS resource startup is approved.

Original workflow downloads public npm/apt/base-image/CA/scanner databases and runs isolated CI containers with fixture configuration; these normal runner requests are not the operator API-call budget. No real tenant DB/Secret or AWS-account identity is provided to the jobs.

Artifacts contain app binaries/source and enter private memory/disk; failing-job logs may contain provider details. Store raw originals/logs privately, do not commit credentials, signed URLs or customer data.

Same source rebuilt twice does not guarantee a distinct image; only real verified config digests can establish a distinct pair. Root/platform manifests remain unverified until later registry publication.
API/ref checks are not cross-service CAS. Another actor/main update or run can race; reject mismatched source/ambiguous runs without using their output or silently broadening scope.

Artifact retention1day and scanner DB freshness48h are independent of the5h preparation snapshot; expiration is never restamped or ignored. Historical media/source evidence is reused, not renewed by this build.
